"""Build and qualify the canonical post-forward waiting-migration candidate."""

from datetime import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET


ROOT = Path("/home/longhao/experiment/.worktrees/beliefkv-v25-followup-20261011")
MAIN = Path("/home/longhao/experiment/BeliefKV")
ENGINE = Path("/home/longhao/experiment/.worktrees/sglang-v292-post-launch-20261013")
PATCH = ROOT / "patches/sglang-v0.5.20-beliefkv-staging.patch"
OUTPUT = ROOT / "experiments/reports/v292_post_launch_qualification_20261013.json"
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from beliefkv.experiments.source_provenance import git_source_state
from scripts.resume_predictive_after_native import engine_delta
from scripts.summarize_semantic_h2d_ab import verify_frozen_execution_source


if OUTPUT.exists():
    raise ValueError("preserve candidate qualification")
started = datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()
checks = {}
for relative, expected in (
    ("experiments/reports/v292_post_launch_engine_junit_20261013.xml", 83),
    ("experiments/reports/v292_post_launch_runtime_junit_20261013.xml", 385),
):
    path = ROOT / relative
    suites = list(ET.parse(path).getroot())
    tests = sum(int(row.get("tests", 0)) for row in suites)
    if tests != expected or any(int(row.get("errors", 0)) or int(row.get("failures", 0)) for row in suites):
        raise ValueError(f"candidate checks failed: {relative}")
    checks[relative] = {
        "tests": tests, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    }
subprocess.run(["git", "add", "--all"], cwd=ENGINE, check=True)
generated = subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "--binary", "HEAD"], cwd=ENGINE)
PATCH.write_bytes(generated)
engine = git_source_state(ENGINE, canonical_patch=PATCH)["canonical_patch"]
delta = engine_delta(ENGINE, MAIN / PATCH.relative_to(ROOT), PATCH)
delta_files = [row for row in delta.decode().splitlines() if row.startswith("diff --git ")]
expected_files = {
    "diff --git a/python/sglang/srt/managers/scheduler.py b/python/sglang/srt/managers/scheduler.py",
    "diff --git a/test/srt/test_beliefkv_scheduler_hook.py b/test/srt/test_beliefkv_scheduler_hook.py",
}
if set(delta_files) != expected_files:
    raise ValueError(f"unexpected engine delta: {delta_files}")
subprocess.run(["git", "apply", "--reverse", "--check", str(PATCH)], cwd=ENGINE, check=True)
paths = (
    "patches/sglang-v0.5.20-beliefkv-staging.patch",
    "beliefkv/runtime/sglang_v0520_runtime.py",
    "tests/test_sglang_v0520_runtime.py",
)
report = {
    "schema_version": 1, "started_at_local": started,
    "qualified_at_local": datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),
    "qualified_engine": str(ENGINE), "engine": engine,
    "main_execution_verification": verify_frozen_execution_source(
        MAIN, "0990b73e639bdf7b23e05e24734c168e2d78d2d6",
    ),
    "checks": checks, "passed": sum(row["tests"] for row in checks.values()),
    "initial_fixture_failure": {
        "path": "experiments/reports/v292_post_launch_runtime_junit_initial_20261013.xml",
        "reason": "The new timing assertion used the default disabled observer; fixture now explicitly enables timing.",
    },
    "engine_delta_files": delta_files,
    "engine_delta_sha256": hashlib.sha256(delta).hexdigest(),
    "qualified_paths_sha256": {
        relative: hashlib.sha256((ROOT / relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        for relative in paths
    },
    "scope": "Single-rank native overlap with execution handoff disabled: waiting JOIN/tool H2D planning and PREPARE follow native forward submission and its WAR barrier. Idle dispatch remains live; unsupported/nonoverlap paths retain the existing order.",
    "limits": [
        "Native page validity, locks, allocation and per-layer data dependencies remain unchanged.",
        "Deferred planning may reduce the remaining anticipatory lead and changes worker-interval clipping.",
        "No throughput, JCT or useful FULL coverage improvement is established by these CPU checks.",
        "V51 source stays frozen; this candidate requires cold deployment.",
    ],
    "helper_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "helper_utf8_source": Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"passed": report["passed"], "engine": engine, "delta_files": delta_files}, indent=2))
